event.details: Fathers individually teach Gaṇeśa worship and varied prescribed mantras to Dakṣa-daughter descendants. They go to forest, perform tapas/Heramba-japa and gain Gaṇeśa appearance after1000 years (no divine qualifier). They hymn Brahman/yoga/peace, protector/creator/preserver/destroyer, beyond māyā while its mover, infinite face/arms and witness, requesting firm devotion ending delusion, capacity in their respective tasks and all wishes fulfilled. Gaṇeśa grants successful intentions, happy devotion, task-capacity and firm fame. He promises hymn users siddhi by faithful hearing/reading and immediate desired fruit from21 readings for21 days; disappears. All men/women descendants return home happy, knowledgeable and successful in tasks.
